title: שמעון בן לוגא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness
attribution: Fresh project English, authored from the frozen Hebrew and revised through source-informed author and independent model review. Editorial-layer attribution in the Warsaw witness remains qualified.
copyright: Girsology project English · Version 1. No downstream reuse license is declared.
paragraphs: Shimon ben Luga told R' Akiva that he and a child from the house of Avtinas saw ma'aleh ashan: Jerusalem Shekalim, chapter 5, halakhah 2 as cited (5:1:21 in the consulted text); Jerusalem Yoma, chapter 3, halakhah 9; Midrash Hazit, at “Who is this coming up?” But Bavli Yoma 38a reads “Yishmael ben Luga,” which Heilprin takes to be a scribal error.
